Metadata.description:
Who a resource is. Identity is `name`; grouping is by label, never by
where the document is stored.

annotations.description: Free notes; never used to select.

uid.description:
Identity that outlives the name: a UUID v4 assigned once, never derived
from the name (Kubernetes `metadata.uid`). Renaming a resource keeps it.

RewriteSpec.description:
The spec of the `Rewrite` record: verdicts recorded under the fingerprint
`legacy`, which the decision's name seeded, belong to `current`, which its
uid seeds. Appended by the first run that finds a finding under both; the
verdicts it moves are not edited, and `log compact` folds the pair.

decisionUid.description: The uid of the decision both fingerprints are of.
